title: GRACE codebook value compression through a shared value basis
hypothesis: With GRACE-style keys/radii fixed, a shared rank-eight value basis plus one discrete codebook index per edit can reduce actual memory bytes versus explicit values while preserving heldout value RMSE <=0.02 and false-trigger rate <=0.005. Compare codebook sizes 16/64/128 against continuous Mirror/native PCA and latent int8.
physical_object: one shared 64x8 counterfactual-value decoder basis and one discrete latent codebook
mirror_coordinate: one codebook index per retrieved edit, decoded to eight basis coordinates
logical_multiplicity: 256 key-addressed edit values; basis/codebook fit uses 192 values and 64 are held out
controls: per-coordinate latent int8 with paid scales
ordinary k-means VQ codebooks with K=16,64,128

task.type: synthetic external local edit memory; values lie exactly on a rank-eight linear subspace
task.vq_fit: Euclidean k-means fit on train latent codes only; 50 Lloyd iterations; seed-fixed initialization

development.selection_metric: heldout value RMSE, route false-trigger rate, actual complete memory bytes, decode/retrieval operations and wall times

paid_objects: all continuous/int8 latent codes OR discrete codebook and indices OR explicit values

compute.operations: All methods compare 256 keys of 32 dimensions and report comparisons; shared latent decode charges 64*8 MACs, VQ lookup charges K*8 distance ops plus 64*8 decode MACs, and basis fit is one-time.

gates.PROMISING: At least one K in both seeds: heldout value RMSE <=0.02, false-trigger rate <=0.005, actual complete bank <=0.75x explicit values, and replay succeeds. A VQ index/codebook has no Mirror-specific claim if native VQ reproduces it exactly; fresh opens only for a distinct View-specific mechanism with a byte-near native control advantage.
gates.FAIL: Explicit upper valid but all frozen value/bytes gates fail, or codebook representation is exactly ordinary native VQ with no Mirror-specific advantage.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Explicit value upper invalid, false-trigger rate >0.01, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Only value representation changes; keys/radii/router remain fixed and fully paid.
The values are deliberately aligned to a shared rank-eight subspace; this is not a natural GRACE lifecycle or language-model edit result.
VQ centers use train values only; heldout values may select a code but cannot tune the centers.
Fresh worlds stay sealed unless frozen promising gates pass.
